issues.description: Function 'calc_val': the problem statement explicitly requires implementing calc_val so that it returns the value 42 in the EAX register, but the solution implementation places 42 into EBX (instruction 'mov ebx, 42' in the solution). This creates a concrete mismatch between the stated return register (EAX) and the solution's return register (EBX), which will confuse students about which register holds the return value and may lead to incorrect student implementations or incorrect grading expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement: in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm replace the instruction 'mov ebx, 42' with 'mov eax, 42' so calc_val returns the value in EAX as specified. Alternatively, if returning the value in EBX was intentional, update the problem statement to state that calc_val returns 42 in EBX. Optionally, add a calc_val stub in the template repository (matching the problem statement) to make the expected return register explicit for students.
